notes.title: 🎇 Update 4.6: Exciting Pet Powers, Fishing Festival & More Rewards!
notes.notes:
Update 4.6 elevates your gaming experience with new Pet Abilities, a competitive Fishing Festival, and a variety of Level Up Rewards, including pet buffs and game enhancements like soil enrichment. Enjoy smoother gameplay with important bug fixes and additional features. Join our vibrant community for ongoing updates and share in the excitement of these new adventures. Your feedback helps shape an even better gaming world. Get ready for fun, surprises, and a richer gaming experience!

[h1]Update 4.6 Overview 🎉[/h1]

[h3][b]New Pet Abilities 🐾[/b][/h3]
[h3][b]Fishing Festival 🎣[/b][/h3]
[h3][b]New Level Up Reward Choices 🎁[/b][/h3]
[h3][b]Additional Features and Bug Fixes 🛠️[/b][/h3]

[h2]New Pet Abilities (Unlocked at Power and Skill Level 5)[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42102462/e6a79957d1da7bd81c3c5480710f1b2468576599.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42102462/c929962c88bbf546aa3b88fdf6f77f7e6fc218ac.jpg[/img]
[b]Healing Aura:[/b] 💚 AoE ground effect that heals player and pet.
[b]Shock Wave:[/b] ⚡ Mimics ogre boss attack.
[b]Tornado:[/b] 🌪️ Damages enemies and attracts items.
[b]Lightning Strike:[/b] ⚡ Summons damaging lightning.
[b]Item Assist:[/b] 🍎 Drops food items from sky.
[b]Fat Chicken:[/b] 🐔 (Chickens only) Drops a chicken to damage enemies.
[b]Fat Cow:[/b] 🐄 (Cows only) Drops a cow to damage enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42102462/2b0eb0d89db640ff9ce3b18a8bae7d02fe8ba70b.jpg[/img]
[b]Web Attack:[/b] 🕸️ Damages enemies with a web.
[b]Toxic Strike:[/b] ☣️ Releases poisonous cloud.
[b]Inky Strike:[/b] 🌫️ Fires blinding ink cloud.
[b]Rocket Claw:[/b] 🚀 Launches explosive claw.
[b]Slime Bomb:[/b] 💣 Walking bomb like a slime boss.
[b]Slime Rocket:[/b] 🚀 Slime rocket that explodes on impact.
[b]Fire Wall:[/b] 🔥 Creates a damaging flame wall.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42102462/1f71bb35132bb8f5c4d157532ef21fbeaa3b79af.jpg[/img]
[b]Charging Slime Cow:[/b] 🐮 (Cows only) Spawns exploding slime cow.

[h2]Fishing Festival Competition 🐟[/h2]
[b]Event: Compete to catch the largest Anglerfish using special worms.[/b]
(We will be improving this festival even more over time.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42102462/dbd810e2c53ff0aea5637ca39d5e999073b855b0.jpg[/img]

[h2]🎉 New Level Up Reward Choices 🎉[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42102462/594129fe5f1a9e311240f0f819db916e2b52ae3f.jpg[/img]

[b]Your Following Pet Gains 2 Random Buffs:[/b] 🐾 Boosts your pet with surprise enhancements.
[b]Rapid Veggie Growth:[/b] 🥕 Speeds up vegetable growth on your farm.
[b]Fruitful Growth:[/b] 🍑 Accelerates fruit growth on your farm.
[b]Dawn Reset:[/b] 🌅 Resets game time to early morning.
[b]Soil Enrichment:[/b] 🌱 Enhances your farm's soil quality.

notes.title: 🎇 Major Update 4.4: Fireworks Festival, New Player & Pet Abilities, and More!
notes.notes:
Exciting news from the farm! Our Major Update 4.4 brings the spectacular Fireworks Festival and a Hot Air Balloon Ride. We're introducing Mr. Mochi, a new talking cat NPC, and spicing things up by making Gertrude, Sakura, and Harold romanceable. Keep an eye out for Mako, Mana, and Bruce, who are set to add more intrigue to our upcoming Tropical Island. We've enhanced your tools with cool new abilities and given your pets powerful new skills. Plus, enjoy our revamped text display settings and the artistic Chicken Festival Posing Minigame. Thanks for your constant support - it's what keeps our farm growing. Happy farming and stay tuned for more!

[h1]🚀 Major Game Update Announcement 🚀[/h1]

[h2]🎆 Fireworks Festival[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42102462/59fefbbbbcc148887858e4403f4875b45e1179a5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42102462/435a0b4d068a9dd127838d105d4ea91522471566.png[/img]

[h2]🎈 Hot Air Balloon Ride[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42102462/d373f18988d2b2c0db969efccd51494b4703e6a9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42102462/d5464b4ec049298fa5ac522b0f4697de2d667e4f.png[/img]

[h2]🐱 Mr. Mochi Male Talking Cat NPC at Wizard’s Windmill (Dialog in progress)[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42102462/e9c121dbdb3df515f4f833fa01c3ee0d791026a4.png[/img]

[h2]🌸 New Dating Options: Gertrude, Sakura, Harold[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42102462/82d6f27939466b2e08fd7be2972afc92b7af7238.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42102462/76c64b116212c760150d53ef5b178d26d2e21282.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42102462/aa9c5187abf8e1a6707711095b1422bb9d7e1652.png[/img]

[h2]🔍 Upcoming NPC Showcase: Mako, Mana, Bruce[/h2]

[h3]Upcoming Character Teaser: 'Mako'[/h3]
Mako's arrival is tied to the future unlock of the Tropical Island 🏝️. His introduction is planned for the later stages of game development, after most other features are added. The exact timing is uncertain as the island's development is still pending, but there's a possibility of an earlier introduction.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42102462/4fb3ca250308cfbab474feedda06b9a208d343c2.gif[/img]

[h3]Upcoming Character Teaser: 'Mana'[/h3]
Mana will become accessible alongside the Tropical Island 🏝️. She is depicted as Mako's older, middle-aged sister, aged 40, adding depth to the island's character dynamics.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42102462/639a022f0a16ac98814940f724627a68359db954.gif[/img]

[h3]Upcoming Character Teaser: 'Bruce'[/h3]
Bruce's story is yet to be revealed. Known for his worldly adventures, he has experienced a wealth of cultures and adventures, making his backstory a blend of mystery and excitement ❤️🏝️😎.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42102462/8693df25d865d3b052962e6caa4d6c7e350637ff.gif[/img]

[h2]🔨 New Player Tool Special Abilities (Iron & Mythril Versions)[/h2]
[h3]Pickaxe:[/h3] 💣 Random Bombs from sky, damage only rocks/enemies
[h3]Axe:[/h3] 🌪️ Small tornadoes, damages enemies, collects items

notes.title: Early Access Update 0.5 (Big Update)
notes.notes:
[h1]Early Access Update 0.5 (Big Update)[/h1]

[h2]Enhancements:[/h2]
Increased frequency of Lost Pet Whistles being available for purchase in the Veggie Barn.
Implemented an Incubator feature, allowing players to hatch fertilized eggs.
Modified scratch card mechanics; now less scratching is required to reveal the reward.
Updated character Byron's age to 27.
Added colors to indicate different Heart Levels.
Added descriptions detailing preferred soil types (sand, clay, silt, loam) to vegetables and grains.
Introduced a pooling system for player movement effects to optimize performance. This covers the walking and sprinting puffs, as well as jump effects.
Boundaries have been enhanced with the addition of colliders in Wilderness, Mountain, and Forest areas.
Added a notification feature for Steam achievements.
Included an Anti-Aliasing toggle which is turned off by default.
Improved the functioning of scroll bars and sliders with controllers. Added snapping for arcade controllers.

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
Resolved discrepancies with items available during the Spring Planting Festival, and adjusted item pricing.
Addressed various issues related to Grape and Blackberry Gemstone Quests.
Fixed a gameplay interruption where skipping dialogues would prevent players from jumping or transitioning between zones.
Addressed an issue with Kerrin's movements; she should now consistently appear in the Veggie Barn.
Corrected Octopus boss references to Squid boss.
Addressed numerous challenges in the Versailles Gemstone quest line.
NPCs will now enter a "shocked" state when brushed, rather than a "bombed" state.
Adjusted cutscene endings to seamlessly transition into seasonal music.
Items that aren't tools no longer display unnecessary bottom bars.
Addressed a bug preventing GUI interaction when pressing the B button on controllers under certain conditions.
Fixed placement issues for the 3D violin and fight mat.

[h2]Miscellaneous:[/h2]
The game now pauses interactions when it's out of focus.
Enhanced the shade deactivation trigger's height for better gameplay interaction.

notes.title: Cornucopia Demo Launches February 3rd
notes.notes:
[b]We are thrilled to unveil that the much-anticipated demo for Cornucopia, a farming RPG featuring unique mechanics and activities, will be available on Steam starting February 3rd.[/b] Not only that, but we will also be participating in Steam Next Fest starting on February 6th, and will be hosting live streams where developers will be showcasing the game, answering questions, and giving an inside look into the game development process.

This is a fantastic opportunity for players to be among the first to dive into the captivating world of Cornucopia, where they will discover unique mechanics such as a magnifying glass and compost system, as well as activities like logging, mushroom foraging, and fun mini-games. The demo will allow players to explore the game's features, provide feedback, and have a hand in shaping the final version of the game.

[b]Don't miss out on this exciting event! Mark your calendars, add the demo to your Steam wishlist, and join us on Steam Next Fest starting February 6th to catch the live streams and be the first to experience Cornucopia.[/b]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/vcPZ8hM/Than.png[/img]
